name: smwmusic-bubba-n-stix-amiga-ending
title: Bubba 'n' Stix (Amiga) - Ending
description:
The ending theme from the Amiga version of Bubba 'n' Stix.
I'd recommend using it on a cutscene, because all channels use the legato command, meaning that if you pause the game while this song is playing and resume, it'll go silent. I know it's lame but it had to be done for the sake of accuracy.

A second version with less legato is also included in order to prevent the song from cutting out when the game is paused.
